initialization: shared generic common_init only, Gseed2060 and independent nativehead2080; no task-checkpoint warm start
augmentation: existing satellite Gaussian p=.5 std=.02 plus ColorJitter; no UAV spatial augmentation
sample_order: torch.randperm(2142,generator=manual_seed(44+epoch))[:2136] in ds.samples order; common root/orders manifest
geometry_control: Recipe controlled whole-path RGB content, explicit geometry content and selected camera IDs; same measured correspondence unless view subset rebuild
native_mask: original roi_local main512 ROI mask supervision unchanged; native128 residual in SAME decoder call; no UDPR/globalUBR/extra boundaryloss
UBR_loss: none; native refiner trained ONLY by original main-mask objective
instance_head: preserved center/offset/logwh objective weight1, logwh internal.1
selection: maximum validation segm/mAP; strict greater only, earliest epoch wins ties
evaluation: old core.inference_outputs, original candidate prefix/supplement/UAV score and mask consumer; source/chunk32 native forward same call
test: after all trainings of the selected stage finish; each recipe own validation-best checkpoint
resume: after_validation epoch boundary; strict arm/source/input/order contract; all five perrank RNG streams and optimizer/scaler restored
resource: every job fourGPU, owner explicit allcard headroom, no singleGPU fallback
limitations: single training seed and development-exposed v1 test; U is a package, not one fusion operator
native_precision: new lightweight head FP32 island, decoder/backbone AMP; delta cast to original logits dtype before add
